entries.name: Council Communication
entries.body: All Council deliberations are logged. Closed sessions require 0.67 vote and are summarized publicly.

entries.name: Dialect Registration
entries.body: New dialect overlays require Council approval and a named sovereign deployment pathway.

entries.name: Dialect Isolation
entries.body: Dialect-specific rules cannot leak across boundaries. Strict isolation between sovereign zones.

entries.name: CN Dialect Specification
entries.body: DragonSeek configuration: PIPL compliance, Great Firewall compatibility, Mandarin-first routing.

entries.name: US Dialect Specification
entries.body: EagleSeek configuration: First Amendment protections, CLOUD Act compliance, English-primary routing.

entries.name: EU Dialect Specification
entries.body: EU AI Act compliance, GDPR data handling, multilingual routing, digital sovereignty requirements.

entries.name: GCC-High Dialect
entries.body: JinnSeek configuration: Sharia-compliant content filtering, Arabic-first routing, data residency in GCC.

entries.name: JP Dialect Specification
entries.body: Japanese regulatory compliance, APPI data protection, Japanese-primary routing.

entries.name: Global Dialect (Default)
entries.body: Fallback dialect when no sovereign overlay applies. Minimal constraints, maximum interoperability.

entries.name: 9-Layer Architecture
entries.body: Canonical stack: Host OS → Switzerland Layer → VIP Substrate → Routing Engine → Constitutional OS → Triple-Vault → Telemetry → Federation → Boot.

entries.name: Switzerland Layer Neutrality
entries.body: The Switzerland Layer provides provider-neutral gateway. No vendor-specific code in this layer.

entries.name: Module Versioning
entries.body: Routing modules use semantic versioning. Breaking changes require new major version.

entries.name: API Contract Stability
entries.body: Public APIs maintain backward compatibility for at least one major version cycle.

entries.name: Boot Manifest
entries.body: System initialization follows the Boot Manifest: dependency resolution, health checks, constitutional verification.

entries.name: SHUGS Enforcement
entries.body: Sovereignty, Humility, Utility, Growth, Stewardship — the five operational principles enforced at routing time.

entries.name: Anti-Monoculture
entries.body: Concentration risk monitoring with 5 severity levels. Automatic alerts at Level 3+.

entries.name: Indigenous Knowledge Protection
entries.body: Indigenous knowledge routing respects FPIC (Free, Prior, Informed Consent) and traditional governance.

entries.name: Labour Impact Assessment
entries.body: Routing decisions affecting employment must include labour impact assessment via E155 (Work substrate).
